Earlier this May, Lux Optics launched a brand-new professional camera app for iPhone — Halide Mark III. Today, the app returns with its first update made specifically for iPhone 18 Pro, and rolls out new features for every iPhone photography enthusiast.

The core idea behind Halide Mark III is to help iPhone users shoot more stunning photos.

It includes a redesigned camera interface, a brand-new photo editor, and Halide Looks that can give photos a specific style.

Building on this foundation, Halide 3.1 arrived in July, adding another Halide Look and more features.

  • Halide Mark III professional iPhone camera app launches with three major photography upgrades
  • Halide 3.1 adds perspective correction, pure RAW shooting and other new features

Now Halide 3.2 is officially here, fully supporting the upgraded iPhone 18 Pro camera system.

Aperture Priority mode

This includes Aperture Priority mode, which takes Halide's capability of freely selecting any aperture value between ƒ/1.48 and ƒ/4.0 even further.

(The built-in iPhone "Camera" app supports an automatic variable aperture mode, or lets you manually choose between ƒ/1.48, ƒ/1.8, ƒ/2.8 or ƒ/4.0.)

The Aperture Priority mode that Halide 3.2 brings to iPhone 18 Pro lets you set a target aperture value, after which Halide will automatically adjust shutter speed and ISO based on the shooting environment.

Meanwhile, the full manual mode lets you directly control ISO.

New Halide Looks: dawn and quicksilver

In addition, Halide 3.2 adds two new styles for all iPhone models: dawn and quicksilver.

dawn "injects cinematic warm tones into the midtones and highlights, paired with soft, layered shadows"; quicksilver, on the other hand, "offers high contrast paired with low-saturation colours, drawing inspiration from the silver-halide archival development process".

Last but not least, Halide 3.2 adds a brand-new 16:9 shooting aspect ratio mode.

Halide Mark III is available as a one-time purchase for US$69.99; subscribers can enjoy this new app for an annual fee of US$19.99.
